headline: Crude Oil Drops as US Inventory Build Offsets Mideast Tensions
summary: Brent crude declined to $92.14 per barrel and WTI slipped 1.9% to $84.40 after US data showed gains in commercial crude and fuel stockpiles, easing supply shortage concerns.
why: Crude oil benchmarks set international energy pricing. Inventory accumulations in the United States often signal softening demand or improving market balance.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Crude benchmarks weakened as US commercial inventory additions outweighed shipping risks.
